Market today: Tech and chip names are facing headwinds today. Concerns about AI spending (Figma, SpaceX) and disappointing forecasts (Sandisk) are weighing on the sector. The Fed's potential move to fewer meetings could also inject more volatility, which hits your leveraged positions hard.

Your holdings: SOXL (-48.11%) and SPAL (-62.31%) are your biggest concerns. Both are leveraged ETFs, meaning drawdowns are amplified, especially on margin. SPAL is a brand-new, very volatile leveraged ETF. SMH (-10.48%) also needs attention.

Watch: Keep a close eye on any further news regarding AI spending and its impact on tech company profitability. Also, monitor overall market volatility as the Fed considers fewer meetings.

Bottom line: Focus on managing risk in your leveraged and underperforming tech/chip positions, especially given the current market sentiment.
plays: Consider trimming SOXL (-48.11%) to reduce exposure to its leveraged decay and significant drawdown.
Review SPAL (-62.31%) given its deep loss and leveraged nature; consider if its stop at 21.38 is appropriate or if a more aggressive cut is needed.
SMH (-10.48%) is a TRIM status; respect its stop at 540 to manage chip sector exposure.
